theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} [DecidableEq α] (h : s ⋖ t) : ∃ a ∈ t, t.erase a = s := by
  let a := (t \ s).choose
  have h1 : a ∈ t := (t \ s).choose_spec.2
  have h2 : a ∉ s := (t \ s).choose_spec.1
  have h3 : t.erase a = s :=
    by
      rw [Finset.erase_union_right_iff]
      exact ⟨h2, Finset.subset.antisymm (Finset.subset.trans (Finset.subset_union_left _) h) Finset.subset.refl⟩
  exact ⟨a, h1, h2, h3⟩
